keyEvents.text: Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 0. Givairo Read (Feyenoord) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jerayno Schaken.
Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 1. Mario Domínguez (Excelsior) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ágúst Thorsteinsson with a through ball.
Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 2. Irakli Yegoian (Excelsior) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Sem Steijn replaces Charles Vanhoutte.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Javi López replaces Tsuyoshi Watanabe.
Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 3. Casper Widell (Excelsior) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Aymen Sliti with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Excelsior. David Garden replaces Mario Domínguez.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Shaqueel van Persie replaces Jerayno Schaken.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Gonçalo Borges replaces Reiss Nelson.
Own Goal by Jan Plug, Excelsior. Feyenoord 2, Excelsior 3.
Delay in match because of an injury Jan Plug (Excelsior).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Excelsior. Eric da Silva Moreira replaces Ágúst Thorsteinsson.
